candidates.name: Hidradenoma Papilliferum
support_spans: Revealed a circumscribed tumor contiguous with adjoining normal epidermis and delineated from underlying dermis by continuous apocrine epithelial lining
Tumor epithelium with multiple papillary projections with vascular, plasma cell–rich stroma
candidates.why: The histopathological examination reveals a circumscribed tumor with apocrine epithelial lining and papillary projections, which is consistent with Hidradenoma Papilliferum.

candidates.name: Apocrine Hidradenoma
support_spans: Revealed a circumscribed tumor contiguous with adjoining normal epidermis and delineated from underlying dermis by continuous apocrine epithelial lining
p63 staining positive in myoepithelial cell layers
candidates.why: The presence of a circumscribed tumor with apocrine epithelial lining and positive p63 staining in myoepithelial cell layers supports the diagnosis of Apocrine Hidradenoma.

candidates.name: Syringocystadenoma Papilliferum
support_spans: Tumor epithelium with multiple papillary projections with vascular, plasma cell–rich stroma
Several foci showed papillary projections lined by multilayered epithelium with atypical cells, few mitotic figures, and areas of necrosis but no dermal invasion
candidates.why: The tumor's papillary projections with vascular and plasma cell-rich stroma, as well as the presence of atypical cells and mitotic figures, are consistent with Syringocystadenoma Papilliferum.

candidates.why: The tumor's epithelium with multiple papillary projections and vascular, plasma cell-rich stroma is also consistent with Syringocystadenoma Papilliferum.

selector.rationale: Both Hidradenoma Papilliferum and Syringocystadenoma Papilliferum have strong support, but Syringocystadenoma Papilliferum is slightly more specific due to the presence of atypical cells and areas of necrosis without dermal invasion, which aligns with its characteristic features.

rejected.label: Apocrine Hidradenoma
rejected.why: Less specific evidence and lower agent votes compared to the top two options.

rejected.label: Apocrine Ductal Carcinoma
rejected.why: Although it has some supporting evidence, the lack of dermal invasion and the presence of atypical cells without clear malignancy features make it less likely than Syringocystadenoma Papilliferum.
